title: Don't Run with Scissors: Pruning Breaks VLA Models but They Can Be Recovered
abstract: arXiv:2510.08464v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a promising paradigm for field robotics, but their deployment is bottlenecked by strict edge SWaP-C constraints. Compression techniques such as quantization, distillation, and pruning are well-established for LLMs and VLMs. Pruning, however, remains particularly underexplored for VLA models. We surprisingly find that pruning VLA models yields drastic performance degradation and increased safety violations. translated_title: 不要手持剪刀奔跑：剪枝会破坏VLA模型，但它们可以被恢复
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型是野外机器人领域一种极具前景的范式，但其部署受到边缘端严格的SWaP-C（尺寸、重量、功耗与成本）约束的瓶颈限制。量化、蒸馏和剪枝等压缩技术在LLM和VLM中已相当成熟，然而剪枝在VLA模型中仍特别缺乏探索。我们惊讶地发现，对VLA模型进行剪枝会导致急剧的性能下降以及安全违规的增加。通过谱分析，我们识别出VLA权重的结构特性，这有助于解释这种脆弱性。基于这一见解，我们提出了GLUESTICK，这是一种剪枝后恢复方法，能够在保留稀疏性优势的同时恢复原始模型的大部分能力。GLUESTICK通过在权重空间中对密集模型与剪枝模型进行插值，计算一个一次性的校正项。在推理时，每个被剪枝的层应用该校正项，以最小的开销恢复损失的性能。
tldr: 剪枝会严重破坏VLA模型并加剧安全违规，本文通过谱分析揭示了其权重结构脆弱性的根源，并提出GLUESTICK方法——通过在权重空间对密集模型与剪枝模型插值计算一次性校正项，在保留稀疏性优势的同时恢复模型大部分性能。
en_tdlr: Pruning drastically degrades VLA models and increases safety violations; the paper's spectral analysis reveals the structural fragility of VLA weights, and the proposed GLUESTICK method computes a one-time corrective term by interpolating between dense and pruned models in weight space, recovering most of the original performance while preserving sparsity benefits.
